protein: MET receptor tyrosine kinase domain; the assayed construct is residues 1059 to 1345 of human MET
readout: Growth fitness of Ba/F3 cells expressing the variant under AMG-458, as a Rosace effect score
assay_method: Deep mutational scan of the MET kinase domain expressed in Ba/F3 cells and grown under inhibitor selection, with variant abundance followed by sequencing and effect scores estimated with Rosace. Condition: AMG-458.
remark: The reference sequence is the assayed construct, residues 1059 to 1345 of UniProt P08581, against which all 287 positions named in the source verify with no mismatch; labels are renumbered to the construct, so add 1058 to a position to recover full-length MET numbering. There is no separate wild-type entry: the scan measures 263 synonymous variants, which carry the wild-type genotype, and their mean is used as the WT row; that set spans -0.743 to 0.4, which is the clearest statement the data offers of the assay's own noise. Nonsense variants are dropped, being written with a non-standard X residue that the four-column format cannot represent. Not extracted from this paper: the exon-14-deleted MET background, which is a different construct and would be its own set of datasets; and the machine-learning feature tables and predictions, which are computed rather than assayed. ProteinGym holds a MET deep mutational scan from the same group published in 2023; this is the inhibitor-profiling study and its measurements are distinct from it.
